answers.question: Does the proposed controller outperform the existing controller under controlled conditions?
answers.answer: No improvement was demonstrated (INCONCLUSIVE). C1-energy: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; C2-meals: INCONCLUSIVE.

answers.question: Can an improvement be attributed to a specific mechanism rather than greater complexity, different seeds or more computation?
answers.answer: There is no demonstrated improvement to attribute. Controls: every controller met the same environment per unit (54 of 54 units met the same environment (food schedule, start, perturbation) under every controller); carrying the plasticity without its action changed nothing (24 of 24 validity runs behaved exactly as the baseline (every metric and the final body and controller hash)). Mechanism family (corrected): plasticity-active − organism in weak-legs: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; plasticity-active − fixed-slow in weak-legs: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; fixed-slow − organism in weak-legs: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; plasticity-active − plasticity-shadow in weak-legs: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT.

answers.question: Does the improvement generalize to previously unseen conditions?
answers.answer: Per condition, plasticity-active − organism on fedJ, corrected over the family: unimpaired: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs: NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs-mild (unseen by the candidate): NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs-severe (unseen by the candidate): INCONCLUSIVE; asymmetric-gait (unseen by the candidate): NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs-noisy-sense (unseen by the candidate): NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs-recovers (unseen by the candidate): NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT; weak-legs-low-reserve (unseen by the candidate): INCONCLUSIVE; weak-legs-diagonal-food (unseen by the candidate): NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT.

answers.question: Does experience produce measurable changes in subsequent behaviour?
answers.answer: The candidate's learned state changed what it did only where it became cautious: unimpaired: detected in 0% of subjects, 0 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs: detected in 100% of subjects, 21985 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-mild: detected in 0% of subjects, 0 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-severe: detected in 100% of subjects, 25671 walking decisions slowed per run; asymmetric-gait: detected in 0% of subjects, 0 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-noisy-sense: detected in 100% of subjects, 43546 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-recovers: detected in 100% of subjects, 8202 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-low-reserve: detected in 100% of subjects, 23019 walking decisions slowed per run; weak-legs-diagonal-food: detected in 100% of subjects, 22802 walking decisions slowed per run. Whether that change helped is Q1 and Q3, not this.

answers.question: How much additional computation does the improvement require?
answers.answer: Per-run CPU, median on this machine under concurrent shards: plasticity-active 10.0 s vs organism 9.8 s for 7200 simulated s. The compute benchmark (single process, interleaved) is the controlled measurement; neither is hardware-independent.

answers.question: Under what conditions does the apparent improvement disappear or reverse?
answers.answer: Regressions (corrected): none detected. The candidate never acted in: unimpaired, weak-legs-mild, asymmetric-gait, so no effect was possible there. The impairment's cost to the baseline was not detected in: weak-legs, weak-legs-mild, asymmetric-gait, weak-legs-recovers, weak-legs-low-reserve, weak-legs-diagonal-food: there, no compensation could have been shown.
